book.name: Apanll Ashtachu Anu
book.title: Apanll ashtachu anu Yuwaa Apanll tputsee wanichu anoo kamankiya Wangarini

content: Yusursha nap ashkuri, uwish mbutsutsinungich kirakaa payupayuw parangina. Kirak yasinamun turimuru, ningeem yandam taaru arangeemsha yandam taaru ashirangiya.
Sheeru, Apanllee wasundurur kapung parangina. Wasundurur kizpurcha. Kizpur k'kuzee zunganeeru, ¿Chak waritaka kirakaa ipursayaru sheeru anush napamaama? tárangiya.
Táyaru, tputsee naxpoorangiya. Nda minamtiyam tputs waritarangiya. Íwarpich nduntamta. Tsapurunasshuch nduntamta. Tsapush wantsush nduntamta. Nda minamtiyam waritarangiya kirakaa natstamaama.
Nuwsha kizpur tanurangina, watam nda minamtiyam waritaranguwa pamaama.

Itaru, wachinsha nuwaa: Tanurinllpa; tárangu. Tputs minam taariya; uw waritariya. Watacha wamari kasiru anu; Apanll Wipaya. Akoparin wip Utaásarini anchichinand tputsi. Dapiyarini kizpur kurak tamapari ashiru anchichtam kizpur shitungarangiya. Manginshuch tumuz tamapari ashiru kizpur taariya, tárangiya wachina tputsi.
Upusanandari xiyxeew parangina. Apanll wasundurur ipunpunaru turipingarangiya. Wachin turipingarangitamsina. Tputs opeejaa yutaritshisheem pachakana an tamapari ashiru parangina.

Wizpuririni izuuru taarangiya. Wits tsimbun matayaru tamapari ashiru wizpuririni taariya. Mishat, ichinguru izuurumamari yasariya. Wach tsimbun matayaru tamapari ashiru yasamaam taariya. An watach Apanll Wani. Uru tsapurunasush shuneeru napkiya, kamachtaku, yasamaam xiykiya.
Nap ashkuri, Waparip naayaru, Waparsha kirakaa payupayuw, uwsha anoo yarangasha.

Yáyaru, Apanllsha wasundurur ipunpunaru anu timucheersin, ungirtarangana. Ashiritam wachinsha ungirtarangitamanaya. Kitar payurutarusin, kitartatarusin yaseeranganaya. Mishat, mangawaa orpat tinam payurangitamanaya. Anush kzammashee tazuyaru mzeezarangiya. Apanll tiptsir Apanllpat tsiyatkusin ashirangana.

yaseerangusin, táranganaya; Shiyamaritish waritaksha kirakaa yamaama; ipursamaam nda xapooksha, wachin, tárangana. Shiy izuuru waritaksha. Shiy iyaam tputseemani ichinguru tsiparangsha. Kurasiriptish iyaa tumashirini tuwaparangsha. Ashiri na Apanllchichshatanicha. Tputsee ichinguru istarangsha. Tsapurunasshuchee shuneerangsha. Kuk ichinguru tsiyatkana anootstam shuneerangsha. Maachiritaatstam, tunareewaatstam ichinguru istarangsha.
Sheeranllush, Apanlleem tiptsiri ichinguru ínarangsha. Ichingurutanicha apanllpanni. Kurakaam iyaa ínarangsha; tsapurunasee shuneeru ishinchiniya, yaseeksin ántarusin mazinarangina.

Ántarusin, yusur naparanguri, Apanllee wasundurur wazapan parangina. ¡Maya! kanindaa tatsitatara ashiranganaya. Yuwash Apanll wasundururpat ipunpunaru, wachinpat shaneerana anoots turipingaranganaya. Ichingurusin washunandari

yaseeksin; Shiyamari waritaktishcha, watam tputseem tsiparangshawa; tárangana. Opeeja tamapari ashiru tputsimand yutaritshishirini tsiparangsha. Ashirucha, shiyaatsimari chinakaniya. Shiy kizpurtishcha. Shiyamaricha kasirish. Shiyamari mangooz kasiru payuksha. Shiyamari ichinguru napaksha. Shiyamari kuraktishcha: yaseeksin ántar ashiranganaya Apanll wasundururi.

Ántarusin, Apanll maacheetsi tinarangu ansha ichinguru Apanllee ungirtaranganaya. Íwarpichtam, kungushchitam, tsapushchitam, tsapurunasshuchtam ztaru ungirtarangana. Kitsi mazinaranguri, Apaa, shiyaa ungirtakaniya; shiy kizpurtishcha; tárangana. Isusoo, shiyaatstam ungirtakaniya; shiy Apanlltishcha Opeejarini, Apanll tinamarini ztaru ántar ashirangana.
Anumunsha, Apanllsha wasundururi; Zuraktishcha, tárangana. Yusursha wachinshtisin timucheersin ungirtarangana. Yuwaa Apanllip yasichinllina anoo kamaneena.
